summary: Frontend retest of the Guardian Journey custom-duration fix. Run on the Expo web preview at 375x667 as voicetest2026@example.com, using fake 900000000x numbers with window.open stubbed. RETEST REASON STILL FAILING (MEDIUM): I picked 30 min, then typed 1441 into guardian-duration-custom one key at a time. guardian-duration-error appears and every Prepare is now aria-disabled: a forced tap gave 0 POSTs and 0 sms links. But the check-in time still shows 144 min (12:46 → 03:10 PM) instead of 30. After blur the text and error clear and Prepare is enabled again, still with 144 in effect, so the user can prepare an SMS with a 144-minute check-in they never chose. Typing 0 after that also falls back to 144. Cause: lastValidDurationRef is updated on every valid keystroke (prefixes 1, 14, 144). Everything else passed. Typing 45 key by key shows in the check-in time and the SMS (tap+45 = 01:32 PM). Picking chip 15 after an invalid value clears the error and the Custom text. OWNER BUG FIXED: a typed destination, 30 min and one Prepare tap made exactly 1 POST (201) and 1 sms: link, with the destination and check-in at tap+30. The row reads 'Message prepared — press Send in your SMS app'. An empty destination shows 'Enter a destination first.' and a forced tap does nothing. Fields lock after the first Prepare. Head Out with 4 hours: the Custom field arrives pre-filled with 240 and locked. The 'Notify your guardian' button has 18px side padding. Other guardian checks passed: one SMS per contact, banner 'prepared for 2 people', muted and no-phone contacts filtered out, empty-circle state, emergency number 112 blocked. 'Track my journey live' shows only with gpsLive=1. A revoked journey shows 'Sharing has ended' on /guardian/<token> with no location leaked. Link-failure wording appears in both the preview and the SMS. Mark-safe and withdraw failures show 'Try again', and retrying mark-safe succeeds. Other features: Silent Alert, /emergency call-112 dialler status, Family Journey, Evidence Locker PIN gate, and Head Out search (3 suggestions) with the map all load. Nothing was opened without a tap, and there were no page errors.

ui_bugs.issue: With 30 min picked, typing 1441 key by key shows the error but leaves 144 min in effect (check-in 03:10 PM instead of 30 min). After blur the error clears, Prepare is enabled again and 144 stays in effect. lastValidDurationRef is set on every valid keystroke (prefixes 1, 14, 144), so 'restore last valid' restores 144. Reference: /app/frontend/app/women/guardian-share.tsx:299-301 and 303-308

action_items: guardian-share.tsx custom duration: do not set lastValidDurationRef on every keystroke. Snapshot the committed duration when editing starts (onFocus: committedRef = durationMins). On an out-of-range value, restore that snapshot. Update the snapshot only on blur, and only when the value is valid, or when a chip is picked. Expected: 30 chip → type 1441 → check-in shows tap+30, and blur keeps 30. Optionally, apply typed values to durationMins only on blur, so prefixes never show in the live check-in time.
critical_code_review_comments: guardian-share.tsx:300 lastValidDurationRef.current = n runs on each keystroke, which defeats the out-of-range fallback (root cause of the remaining bug).

useJourneyGPS.ts:171-173: when watchPositionAsync throws, the hook returns silently without setting state.error. The UI can keep showing 'Starting location tracking…' on native with no failure message. Minor.
useJourneyGPS.ts:182: the effect cleanup calls subRef.current?.remove() without try/catch, while line 134 wraps the same call. Minor inconsistency.

rca_of_issue: onChangeText validates each keystroke. Valid prefixes (1, 14, 144) are written to both durationMins and lastValidDurationRef. When the 4th key makes 1441, the invalid branch restores lastValidDurationRef, which is already 144. onBlur restores the same ref. The 'last valid' value must be the one committed before the edit (chip or blurred value), not the last valid keystroke.
